description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based web application. It sets up the rendering of the root React component within the DOM element with id 'root', wrapping it in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues during development.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering React components inside a specific DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React components into the specified DOM node.
